title: Zul'Farrak
body: Zul'Farrak is the city of the Sandfury trolls, and inside its walls the desert sky still stands open overhead. Streets of sand wind between temples of old stone, past graves and shrines and a great stepped pyramid. The Sandfury hold all of it, blood drinkers and shadowcasters, witch doctors and shadowhunters, and their dead do not always stay dead. Scarabs swarm the sands, basilisks crawl among the ruins, and the tribe's rulers and holy places are closely guarded.

parts.body: The Sandfury make a tempering agent from sandstone, and the smiths of Gadgetzan pay well for goods tempered with it.
sources: tools/research/zones/zulfarrak.txt (1176 the only area on map 209)

parts.body: The scarabs of Tanaris were hunted nearly to extinction for their hard shells. In Zul'Farrak they thrive, for the trolls do not hunt them.

title: The Sacred Pool
body: Deep in Zul'Farrak lies the sacred pool of the Sandfury, a broad sheet of still water in a city of sand. Gahz'rilla, the hydra the trolls revere, dwells in its depths, and a great gong at its edge calls him up. The hydromancer Velratha walks the shore as if the water were hers to command, and the tribe keeps the manner of the summoning a close secret.

parts.body: Velratha's agents stole the Tiara of the Deep, a jewel of great power, from the home of the mage Tabetha of Dustwallow, and Tabetha wants it back.

title: Theka the Martyr
body: Theka the Martyr died long ago, yet he still walks Zul'Farrak, an undead troll pacing the ground about his tomb, where the city's scarabs gather in their dozens. It is said they were once his persecutors, cursed into the shape of the beetles that now scuttle about his shrine. What made him a martyr, and to whom, the city does not tell outsiders.

parts.body: Theka and Velratha each held a tablet of the prophecy of Mosh'aru, which tells of a way to contain the essence of the god Hakkar. The old mystic Yeh'kinya wanted both.

parts.body: Both tablets went to Steamwheedle Port, where Yeh'kinya fused them together to study their hidden secrets, and said that his debt to their bearer would grow further still.

title: The Great Pyramid
body: The great pyramid of Zul'Farrak rises in broad steps above the sand, and on the platform at its top the Sandfury keep their prisoners in cages, an executioner standing over them. When captives are freed the whole tribe musters below, slaves and zealots climbing the stairs in wave after wave, led at the last by the shadowpriest Sezz'ziz and the undead warrior Nekrum Gutchewer.

title: Sergeant Bly
body: Sergeant Bly led a band of adventurers to Zul'Farrak to hunt treasure, Raven, Oro Eyegouge, Murta Grimgut and the goblin Weegli Blastfuse, and the trolls caged them atop the great pyramid for sacrifice. From his cage Bly promises anything to whoever gets them out, and Weegli offers to blow open the door to the chief.

parts.body: Bly had taken a divino-matic rod from Gadgetzan's chief engineer, saying he would only borrow it, and it went home to Gadgetzan from his body.
sources: npc_text 1515 (gossip before the cages open: my band and I captured by trolls, going to sacrifice us; get us out and I'll give you anything you want)

parts.body: Once free, Bly told his rescuers to forget anything he had said about repaying them, and his band turned on them.

title: Chief Ukorz Sandscalp
body: Chief Ukorz Sandscalp rules Zul'Farrak from a high terrace over the city, reached only past a heavy door not far from the great pyramid, where great serpents and hulking basilisks keep guard with him and the warrior Ruuzlu stands at his side. The Sandfury reign supreme, he roars, and those who reach him will feel the fury of the sands.
